Subject: EdgeNova onboarding docs (COI + W9)

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the quick intro call this week — excited to get started. Attached are the initial onboarding documents you requested: Certificate of Insurance (COI), W-9, and our completed vendor risk questionnaire. Let me know if anything is missing or if you need insurer contact details for endorsement.

Attachments (stubs): EdgeNova_COI_2026-01-14.pdf (COI, general liability limits), EdgeNova_W9_2026-01-14.pdf, RiskQuestionnaire_Signed_2026-01-14.xlsx

Head of Finance Operations
EdgeNova, Inc.
alex.kim@edgenova.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-01-15T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: EdgeNova onboarding docs (COI + W9)

Thanks Alex — received the files. Quick checklist from procurement/legal so we can move to PO:

- COI: need waiver/endorsement language confirming Redwood Inference is an additional insured on the general liability policy (endorsement CG 20 10 or equivalent).
- Effective dates: confirm the policy covers the period of the PO (anticipated start 2026-02-01).
- Insurer contact/email and policy number for verification.
- W-9: looks good.
- Risk questionnaire: review underway, will follow up on any high-risk responses.

Marissa (procurement) and Sean (legal/finance) are looped to confirm wording for the additional insured endorsement and whether we can proceed with a conditional PO pending the endorsement. If you can provide the insurer contact and confirm the endorsement wording is possible, we can issue a conditional PO to allow for setup in our systems.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Senior Vendor Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Kim <alex.kim@edgenova.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@edgenova.com
Date: 2026-01-16T08:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: EdgeNova onboarding docs (COI + W9)

Hi Mina — thanks for the checklist. Quick responses inline: 

- Endorsement: our broker has confirmed they can add Redwood Inference as an additional insured with the standard CG 20 10 endorsement.
- Effective dates: policy active through 2026-12-31; we can extend if needed.
- Insurer contact: Beacon Insurance Group, broker email broker-support@beaconins.com; policy # GN-889112.

I've attached the same COI with broker contact highlighted and our signed risk questionnaire. If Marissa/Sean want the broker to send the endorsement directly to your risk team, we can request that and provide a confirmation letter. Let us know which is preferred.

Alex

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Kim <alex.kim@edgenova.com>
Date: 2026-01-18T10:46:00-08:00
Subject: Re: EdgeNova onboarding docs (COI + W9)

Looping in our typical next steps and a proposed path to keep onboarding moving: 

1) We can issue a conditional PO (one-time setup) to avoid blocking the SOW kickoff, but the PO must be explicitly conditional on receipt of the additional insured endorsement within 10 business days.
2) Sean — please confirm the endorsement wording below is sufficient for legal: "Redwood Inference, its officers, directors, and employees are added as additional insureds with respect to operations performed by EdgeNova under the agreement."
3) Alex — if you can ask Beacon Insurance Group to email the endorsement to broker-support@redwood.ai and cc contracts@edgenova.com, please do. A PDF delivered from the insurer is preferred to a broker note.

If legal signs off, I will create the conditional PO and send the DocuSign link to Alex so EdgeNova can accept and we can route to accounting. 

Thanks — trying to keep the SOW sprint on track for Feb 1 start.

Marissa Cole
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Kim <alex.kim@edgenova.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-01-20T17:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: EdgeNova onboarding docs (COI + W9)

Thanks everyone — Sean confirmed the endorsement language is acceptable (see below). Marissa has prepared a conditional PO and I have created the DocuSign envelope.

Action items for EdgeNova:
- Please coordinate with Beacon Insurance Group to send the signed endorsement PDF to broker-support@redwood.ai within 10 business days.
- Sign the conditional PO via DocuSign (link below). The PO is explicitly conditional on receipt of the endorsement; payment terms will follow standard Redwood vendor schedule once endorsement is verified.

Attached: Redwood_PO_Conditional_EdgeNova_DN-4321.pdf (PO stub — conditional).
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/link/edge-nova-po-DN4321

We will not provision production access until the endorsement is received, but we will complete the vendor setup in our ERP so invoicing can be processed quickly once cleared. If there are any questions about the wording or timing, reply here and we will escalate.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Vendor Ops
Redwood Inference

Sean Gallagher (legal) confirmed acceptance: "Redwood Inference, its officers, directors, and employees are added as additional insureds with respect to operations performed by EdgeNova under the agreement."
